recipe.variant: an image at an EXACT width x height, no model: ImageScale (lanczos) with crop 'center' — scales to cover the target, then trims the overflow from the middle. For the last step of a design whose earlier stage cannot set the size (a reference edit keeps its input's shape at about 1 MP)
recipe.from_template: the core ImageScale node as the official templates use it (hidream_e1_full, sd3.5_large_canny_controlnet_example: ImageScale [method, width, height, 'center'])

method.note: lanczos for photos; area when shrinking a lot

crop.note: center keeps the proportions and trims the overflow; disabled stretches to fit

image.note: the image to bring to the exact size (usually an earlier stage's result)

recipe.defaults_note: No model and no GPU work to speak of. Enlarging more than ~1.5x softens the image: for a big enlargement use an upscale model first (upscale-image-photo), then this to land on the exact size.
verify: core nodes only (LoadImage, ImageScale, SaveImage) present in the v0.35.0 registry; built 2026-10-04
